title: stancebar
summary: MSUI implements the current Benilla stance/form bar through a dedicated positioning and behavior law: exact AttributesEx2 admission/exclusion gates, aura-36 form extraction, signed StanceBarOrder sorting, live form-byte/own-aura active latch, active icon swap, castability tint, cooldown swipe/flash, checked/pushed/highlight layers, spell tooltip, cast/cancel clicks, SpellShapeshiftForm warrior no-cancel flags, ten-button geometry, and the UIParent-managed +30,+45 seat above the always-visible lower action row. Pet-or-stance visibility now feeds the neighboring bottom-stack consumers.

openItems.text: Entire stance bar surface: form buttons (icon/checked/castable tint/cooldown), show/hide on form count, click-to-cast the form spell, hover tooltip
openItems.resolution: GameLoop.StanceBar renders the law-selected form list with stock icon/ring/check/highlight layers, usability tint, cooldown display, shared spell tooltip and isolated hit targets; inactive entries cast while active cancelable entries send CancelAura.

openItems.text: Managed bottom-stack reposition on bar show/hide (the law knows the anchor but nothing consumes it)
openItems.resolution: StanceBarUiLaw consumes UiParentUiLaw's ShapeshiftBar placement and PetOrStanceActionBarVisible is shared by casting, tooltip, party and group-loot bottom-stack consumers.
